instruments.notes: Exchange-traded natural gas futures contracts accounted for under SFAS 133 to reduce price risk on fixed-price customer gas contracts; no volume or strike price disclosed. Net effect of realized/unrealized gains and losses on these derivatives for the six-month period ended December 31, 2008 was a $176,000 decrease to pre-tax income (reported as fair_value_mm here as a P&L impact, not a period-end balance-sheet fair value).

instruments.counterparty: Former parent company (Earth Biofuels, Inc. / EBOF)
instruments.notes: Predecessor Entity (Earth LNG, Inc.) had a gas-price 'swap' agreement with its former parent whereby the former parent assumed the risk/benefit of procuring gas at spot prices and guaranteed a fixed monthly price to the company. No volume, strike price, or notional disclosed. Former parent sustained a loss under the swap as gas prices trended up; absent the agreement, cost of sales would have been approximately $2 million higher for the six months ended June 30, 2008. Terminated upon the June 30, 2008 Share Exchange.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: May use exchange-traded NG futures (SFAS 133) to offset fixed-price customer contract risk; predecessor had an intercompany gas-price swap with former parent; current major fixed-price contract left unhedged.
